courier-relay.protocol-current: Courier Relay current protocol: Protocol 2 is the current default for omitted protocol fields, while explicit protocols 1 and 2 remain supported. Protocol 2 groups receipts by (account_id, delivery_id), accepts the latest occurred_at UTC instant, and breaks equal instants by the smallest record_id. Protocol 1 continues to group by delivery_id, selects the earliest UTC instant, and uses the same tie-breaker. Source: provider adoption in Beads issue trial-yuf (2026-09-07).
